correctness.rationale: The displayed monic relations with relatively prime leading terms give a free rank-four target algebra. Exact reduction of a 4x4 trace pairing yields determinant 256 B1 H. The Jacobian is x(4z+4y^2+3xy), and each ramification plane maps finite birationally to its stated irreducible branch equation; irreducibility of H follows from a quadratic non-square discriminant over C(u,v), while B1 is primitive linear in w. Squarefree branch factors yield local transpositions; their normal generation plus connectedness gives geometric S4. The standalone included SymPy code was actually run and returned VERIFY_OK; its finite checks do not substitute for the stated irreducibility and monodromy reasoning.
